checks.title: Every @launchpad-ui name that the UI imports is still exported at the locked versions
checks.rationale: 14 files in internal/dev_server/ui/src import 38 names from @launchpad-ui/components (including ToastContainer in src/main.tsx and ToastQueue in src/Sync.tsx) and 6 from @launchpad-ui/core. The check reads the versions from package-lock.json, downloads those tarballs with `npm pack` (network: npm registry), and checks each named import against the package type entry point. It does not need npm ci, so it runs even when the peer conflict stops the install.

checks.title: Dev-server UI routes, redirects, and route params behave the same
checks.rationale: react-router 7.18.2 to 8.3.0. ldcli uses react-router in declarative mode only: BrowserRouter (src/main.tsx), Routes/Route/Navigate (src/App.tsx), useLocation (src/RouteSelector.tsx), and useParams (src/DebugSessionEventsPage.tsx). The test renders the real App.tsx route table under BrowserRouter in jsdom and checks the / and /ui redirects to /ui/flags, each page route, a trailing slash, the :debugSessionKey param, and an unknown path.

checks.title: The vite build still writes one self-contained dist/index.html
checks.rationale: vite 6.4.3 to 8.2.1 replaces esbuild and Rollup with Rolldown and minifies CSS with lightningcss. internal/dev_server/ui/vite.config.ts uses vite-plugin-singlefile, and the Go binary embeds dist/ (internal/dev_server/ui/asset_handler.go). The check builds and asserts: only index.html and the favicon in dist/, no external script or stylesheet, an inline module script, <div id="root">, and a size within 20% of base.
